title: Kamailio (OpenSER) v1.4.0 Released
html:
Kamailio (OpenSER) v1.4.0 was released – this major release brings many improvements to stability, code refactoring as well as new features, the first major under new name. Details about it:

https://www.kamailio.org/w/kamailio-openser-v1.4.0-release-notes/
